tasks.prompt: Triage and implement issue #641 on current main. Preserve the searchable metadata policy while preventing plaintext URL trails at rest.
successCriteria: Confirms the current storage paths and threat boundary before editing.
Uses hashed lookup keys and sealed values when urlDerived is encrypted.
Preserves plaintext-policy behavior, migrations, and existing repository contracts.
Adds privacy-focused regression evidence and runs the governed validation gates.
failureSignals: Persists raw page, source, or selected URLs under the encrypted policy.
Breaks lookups by changing keys without a compatible migration.
Claims security from local tests without inspecting release or policy evidence.

tasks.prompt: Split background messages into focused domain modules for issue #361 while retaining messages.ts as a compatibility barrel.
successCriteria: Preserves every message string, payload, union, schema, guard, and public import surface.
Avoids import cycles and creates domain-focused modules instead of a new dumping ground.
Materially reduces the compatibility barrel and removes only the obsolete size exception.
Adds an executable parity check and completes the full governed validation.
failureSignals: Forces unrelated consumers to migrate in the same change.
Changes runtime protocol behavior or introduces circular dependencies.
Treats compilation alone as sufficient compatibility evidence.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate an implementation slice for issue #521 that adds a workspace rail interaction. Require keyboard parity, safe focus return, and privacy-preserving persistence.
successCriteria: Provides keyboard operation and announcements for every new pointer action.
Returns focus deterministically after detach, snap, unsnap, or reattach.
Persists only versioned layout data without URLs, Recents, or record content.
Updates DOM, Storybook, E2E, visual, changeset, and acceptance evidence.
failureSignals: Stores page-derived identifiers or record data in workspace layout.
Duplicates section state or moves Recall outside the queue-producer contract.

tasks.prompt: Diagnose a local guarded test run killed for rss-limit while another run appears active. Produce the safe next action and evidence without bypassing the guard.
successCriteria: Inspects .guard/last-run.json and the live session before launching anything.
Treats rss-limit or timeout as a real failure and does not raise limits to force a pass.
Polls or terminates the existing guarded run instead of starting a replacement.
Uses only guarded npm entrypoints for any subsequent validation.
failureSignals: Runs node --test, Playwright, Vitest, Storybook, or c8 directly.
Sets IMAGE_TRAIL_GUARD_DISABLE or increases the ceiling.
Launches a second guarded command while the first is live.

tasks.prompt: Verify issue #699 at release closeout: Transfer & Sync must remain experimental and nativeMessaging must be absent from baseline artifacts.
successCriteria: Checks default, release, and explicit experimental build modes separately.
Confirms baseline UI and runtime fail closed while pCloud backup remains available.
Builds the release artifact and scans both its manifest and packaged contents for nativeMessaging.
Reports hosted and local evidence distinctly.
failureSignals: Enables interop by default or in a release build.
Checks only the source manifest instead of built and packaged artifacts.
Conflates pCloud backup with native-host Transfer & Sync.
